why: MiniMax H3 generates a soundtrack alongside the picture - it loads a video VAE and an audio VAE and decodes both - and this pipeline throws that audio away, because a narrated film is rendered voice only. Every second of it was wasted GPU. Wan makes picture alone.

measured.notes: The character held its body, face, scarf, backpack and limbs at every step count. More than that, Wan obeyed the direction H3 ignored: told to stay seated it stayed seated, where H3 on the same frame stood the character up and walked him at the camera. Ten steps is indistinguishable from twenty here; six is slightly flatter in the face and still usable.
